cues.en: I'll reconstruct each victim's head in turn.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear

cues.speaker: Metal Gear

cues.speaker: Metal Gear

cues.speaker: Metal Gear

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: 1. Whether fontanelles remain, and skull suture clarity.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: 2. The area of the facial skeleton.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: 3. The height of the upper and lower jaws,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: and development of the tooth-bearing ridges.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: 4. The skull's center of gravity.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Next, sex.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: 1. Overall skull size.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: 2. The angle and slope of the crown.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: 3. Development of the facial skeleton.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Finally, race.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: 1. Skull measurements.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: 2. Cranial cavity volume.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: 3. Skull weight.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: From these results, I'll add flesh

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: using average measurements for each part.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: First stage of reconstruction complete.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Ten percent margin of error from racial averages.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Adding estimated hairstyle and eyes.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The first victim's head is reconstructed.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The Chief!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: What?!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The Chief was a Snatcher!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The Benson in the record was Benson Cunningham?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Judging by the body's condition,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: he was snatched about a month ago.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The Chief sabotaged the Tricycle too.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The Outer Heaven matches in Harry's room were planted to frame him.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Harry must have realized and left the "Face to face" note.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Wait! Mika said Harry followed the Chief. That's right!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: So he went looking for evidence against the Chief.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: That old man's in danger, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: If the Chief sabotaged the Tricycle,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: he must already know we've discovered what he is.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Damn it! Harry and Mika are in danger!

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: That's far enough, JUNKER!

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Your little detective game is over!

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: That's far enough, JUNKER. Your detective game is over.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: It's them! Snatchers! Get them!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: My arm! My Blaster! My leg's been hit!

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: What a sorry sight, JUNKER!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Who's there? Chin! Chin Shu Ho, you bastard!

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Still have some fight left, JUNKER? You're finished.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Our plan is entering its second phase, Level 2.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Then this city and the entire world will be ours.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Second phase? What do you mean?

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: As you know, our movements have been restricted

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: by our imperfect artificial skin.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: It forces us to avoid ultraviolet rays and hide underground.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: We can only operate on winter nights.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: We even need a hospital like this.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: All because of our imperfect artificial skin.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: It is the only difference between us and humans.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: But at last, we can overcome that tiresome limitation.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What?

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: We've found the key to perfect artificial skin,

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: thanks to a new collaborator.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Perfect artificial skin? A new collaborator?

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Once it's complete, nothing will hold us back.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: With that skin,

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: our snatching plan will enter its second phase, Level 2.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Our experiment in this city will become

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: a full-scale invasion of the world.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Don't get carried away. You won't leave this city so easily.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Humans are such hopeless fools.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: What?!

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: You know tomorrow's Kyoto summit will discuss the Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: We will attack the summit.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Fool! Security's too tight.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: You won't even get close, let alone inside.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Must I explain everything, JUNKER?

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Surely you've heard that a JUNKER will attend as a special adviser.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The Chief! Cunningham! That's why you snatched him!

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: We've known for six months that the Chief would attend.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The summit is tomorrow, Gillian. We must hurry!

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: The Chief and all of JUNKER are in our hands. This city too.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Tomorrow, the whole world. No one remains to stand in our way.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: At last, we will avenge what happened fifty years ago.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Who the hell are you?

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Us? Deep within the Kremlin, our creator Madnar gave us life.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: We are the chosen people, the next stage of evolution.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Madnar? Kremlin? Those names sound familiar.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Our goal is to snatch the world's VIPs.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Then control the thoughts of every race,

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: everywhere, and unite all peoples.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Who's controlling you?

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Like the Nazis, we begin our invasion

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: by terrorizing the human mind.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: We provoke and amplify doubt,

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: the weakness at the root of the human psyche.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: That destroys trust, the foundation of human society.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Doubt is humanity's most primitive, and most fragile, weakness.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Our plan needs only a gentle touch at that point.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: We'll all die if this goes on, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: You have to make it back alive. You're a JUNKER.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What are you planning, Randam?

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Some big fireworks.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: You'll blow yourself up before you let them snatch you?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Let's fight them together, Randam!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: No. My thigh's been hit. Damn it.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: A leg wound is fatal for a bounty hunter.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Do you have a chance?

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: I'm not a bounty hunter for nothing.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: I've prepared for situations like this.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: I've always held on to things. December's late for fireworks.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Call it a year-end show. My belt is packed with TNT-PX. Powerful stuff.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: They use it in the mines on Mars.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: One button will blow this hospital sky-high. No time to think.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Go, JUNKER! What are you waiting for, coward?

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Escape through this vent!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: I'll set off a powerful flash to confuse their sensors.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Use that chance to get as far away as you can. Got it?

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Watch the fireworks from a distance, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: Finished your goodbyes? Then it's time for you to die.

cues.speaker: Chin
cues.en: We have work to do.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: On my signal, break through the vent and run.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Don't forget your Blaster.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Stay with me, Metal.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Yes.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Randam!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Looks like you'll still owe me one, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I'll pay them back for both of us.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Go!
